# Zep Memory — Project Memory Config

Zep provides long-term memory and knowledge graphs for AI assistants.

## Setup

1. Sign up at https://getzep.com
2. Create a project and API key
3. Install the Zep MCP server:

```bash
npx -y @getzep/zep-mcp@latest
```

## Environment

```
ZEP_API_KEY=your_key_here
```

Docs: https://docs.getzep.com/integrations/mcp
